question.text: Will the U.S. and Iran return to war before December 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as Yes if, after November 2, 2026 and before December 1, 2026, the United States military carries out a lethal kinetic strike against the mainland territory of Iran, according to [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions).
question.fine_print:
To qualify, an attack must be [kinetic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kinetic_military_action), using explosive weaponry or physical violence, and it must be lethal, resulting in at least one death.

Strikes against vessels in the Strait of Hormuz do not qualify.

***
This question's information (resolution criteria, fine print, background info, etc) is synced with an [original identical question](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/46325) which opened on 2026-11-02 18:00:00. This question will resolve based on the resolution criteria and fine print of the linked original question. However, if this question would resolve differently than the original question, then this question will be annulled. Additionally, if the original question's resolution could have been known before this question opened, then this question will be annulled.

research:
Short answer: as of November 7, nothing has happened yet that would make this question resolve Yes. The U.S. did strike Iran's Qeshm Island twice after the midterms, but no deaths were reported and Qeshm is an island, not mainland Iran.

### 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on "credible sources" (Metaculus definition), not on a single data series. I tried to open the original Metaculus question (46325) but got a 403 error, so I could not see its community forecast or whether Metaculus counts islands as mainland. [metaculus](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/46325)
- A Yes needs all three of these: a U.S. strike, on Iran's mainland territory, that kills at least one person, between November 2 and December 1. Strikes on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz do not count.

### 2. Current status
- 2026-11-02 (Monday night): the U.S. carried out limited "defensive" strikes on Qeshm Island, reportedly hitting a missile launcher after Iran shot down a U.S. drone. U.S. officials said this was "not a resumption of major combat." Iranian state media reported explosions but no casualties. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/02/politics/us-strikes-iran-qeshm-island), [NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/us-conducted-defensive-strikes-iranian-targets-strait-hormuz-us-offici-rcna607161), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/03/us-strike-qeshm-iran-hormuz/)
- 2026-11-03: Trump confirmed a "minor attack" on an anti-aircraft site and said it "wasn't war." No casualties were reported. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/4/iran-says-us-reply-to-hormuz-plan-unconvincing-trump-confirms-strikes)
- 2026-11-06: a second round of "minor strikes" hit air defences in the Suza area of Qeshm. Iran said it shot down a U.S. MQ-9 drone over the island. No deaths were reported, and Central Command called the situation "relatively calm." [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/7/trump-confirms-new-us-strikes-on-irans-qeshm-island)
- Neither strike seems to qualify. Both were on an island and neither was reported as lethal. Still, they show a pattern of tit-for-tat strikes on Iranian territory. If a later report finds deaths, or if strikes move to the coast, the question could flip.

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-07: The U.S. offered up to a $20M reward for information on Iran's nuclear program. [tag24](https://www.tag24.de/thema/israel/nahost-konflikt-tote-zivilisten-im-jemen-gegenseitige-schuldzuweisungen-3543485)
- 2026-11-06: On whether to resume the war, Trump said "I would rather not destroy the rest of the country if possible, but maybe I have to," and that he would decide soon. In Israel, a 67-seat majority is forming a new government. [tag24](https://www.tag24.de/thema/israel/nahost-konflikt-trump-will-bald-genug-ueber-iran-krieg-entscheiden-3543485)
- 2026-11-05: Trump met his national security team. He is weighing three options: new strikes, continued economic pressure, or a deal with major Iranian concessions. The NYT reports that thousands of U.S. air and naval forces are ready to resume major combat. [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/11/05/trump-iran-war-national-security-team-decision), [Breitbart](https://www.breitbart.com/politics/2026/11/05/trump-decision-renewed-strikes-iran-coming-soon/)
- 2026-11-05: Snopes rated reports of a planned nuclear strike as unproven. [Snopes](https://www.snopes.com/news/2026/11/05/trump-iran-nuclear-strike/)
- 2026-11-05: Court documents show the U.S. and Iran held secret talks on deportations as recently as mid-October. [CTV](https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/trump-administration-held-talks-with-iran-on-deporting-iranians-during-the-war-court-documents-show/)
- 2026-11-04: Bloomberg reported Trump played down the prospect of strikes after Democrats swept the midterms, saying "We've made a lot of progress with Iran." Bloomberg said the next few weeks are key, since Trump may want to act before the new Congress is seated in January. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-04/trump-plays-down-prospect-of-strikes-on-iran-after-midterm-rout)
- Early November: Iran called the U.S. reply to its Hormuz plan "unconvincing." Qatar says it is still hopeful of a deal. Iran's chief negotiator Ghalibaf said Iran has its "finger on the trigger." [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/4/iran-says-us-reply-to-hormuz-plan-unconvincing-trump-confirms-strikes), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.pk/world/qatar-says-remains-hopeful-of-a-us-iran-deal-trump-confirms-strikes-on-qeshm-3005976)

### 4. Base rates
- U.S. strikes on Iran this year: the main war from February 28, strikes on May 7, a June interim deal followed by days of exchanged strikes, the ceasefire declared "OVER" in July, and the September strikes. That means U.S. strikes on Iranian territory happened in most months from March to September. October was quiet because of Trump's pledge not to strike before the midterms. [Wikipedia May 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/7_May_2026_United_States_strikes_on_Iran), [L'Orient](https://today.lorientlejour.com/article/1540920/trump-says-us-agrees-to-more-iran-talks-but-cease-fire-over.html)
- Many of the "defensive" strikes around Hormuz hit islands or launchers and caused no reported deaths. So the mainland-plus-lethal test is narrower than simply "the U.S. struck Iran." I could not find a month-by-month count of lethal mainland strikes.

### 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket "US-Iran ceasefire continues through Nov 30": undated mirror sites show about 17-28% for Yes, and one report says the bucket closed at "No" (meaning a strike already counted under that market's broader rules, which include any U.S. air or missile strike hitting Iran). I could not confirm a live price. [polymarkets.co.il](https://polymarkets.co.il/en/market/us-iran-ceasefire-continues-through-the-midterms/), [Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/iran-ceasefire-odds-fall-20-points-to-78-percent/)
- Polymarket, US officially declares war on Iran by December 31: 2.1%. Next senior U.S.-Iran diplomatic meeting by November 30: 28.5%, by December 31: 45%, with Qatar the most likely venue at 17%.
- Kalshi, US-Iran nuclear deal before December 1: 1%; before January 1, 2027: 6%.
- Manifold (play money): "Conflict in Iran after US midterms" 67%; "US and Iran at war on Jan 1, 2027" 74%; U.S. uses a MOAB bomb inside Iran between November 4 and 30: 40%. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/event/post-us-midterms-2026-iran-conflict)
- I found no market that matches this question's exact terms (lethal, mainland, November 2 to 30).

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Trump's promised "soon" decision on resuming the war; a pivot to strikes on mainland targets could follow quickly.
- More incidents around Qeshm and the Strait of Hormuz, such as drone shootdowns and U.S. reprisals, that could spread to coastal or mainland sites.
- A possible senior U.S.-Iran meeting, likely in Qatar, and Iran's response to the Hormuz proposals.
- Israel's new government, and how closely it coordinates with the U.S.
- Reported Iranian plots against U.S. officials, which could trigger retaliation.
- The lame-duck period before the new Congress sits in January 2027.

# US-Iran: lethal US strike on mainland Iran, Nov 2 to Dec 1, 2026 (research only, no forecast)

**Summary:** As of Nov 7, nothing settles this question. The US has struck Iran twice since the window opened, but both strikes hit Qeshm Island and no deaths were reported. Trump says a decision on major strikes is coming "soon", and CENTCOM is ready but has no order.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question has no data series. It resolves on "credible sources" reporting a lethal US kinetic strike on Iran's **mainland** between Nov 2 and Dec 1, 2026. Strikes on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz do not count.
- 2026-11-07: The Metaculus page (post 46325) returned HTTP 403, so I could not see its community forecast or any status notes. [Metaculus](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/46325)
- I found no Wikipedia page yet for November 2026 strikes. The September strikes article was last edited Oct 7. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_2026_United_States_strikes_on_Iran)

## 2. Current status
- **Not resolved.** Both post-Nov 2 strikes hit Qeshm Island, and no casualties were reported for either. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/7/trump-confirms-new-us-strikes-on-irans-qeshm-island)
- Open interpretive point: Qeshm is an island in the Strait of Hormuz. Whether an island counts as "mainland territory" is unclear, but the "mainland" wording suggests it may not. Even if it did, no deaths have been reported, so these strikes would not qualify as described.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-07: The US offered up to $20M for information on Iran's nuclear program. [tag24](https://www.tag24.de/thema/israel/nahost-konflikt-tote-zivilisten-im-jemen-gegenseitige-schuldzuweisungen-3543485), [Outlook India](https://www.outlookindia.com/international/us-iran-nuclear-programme-20-million-reward-qatar-mediation-trump-talks-strait-of-hormuz)
- 2026-11-07: Trump's advisers are reported split:
  - Vance and Witkoff favor a deal.
  - Rubio, Ratcliffe and Bessent favor keeping the naval blockade and economic pressure, with no new strikes and no deal.
  - CENTCOM is finishing preparations for major combat but has no directive. [HNGN](https://www.hngn.com/articles/273722/20261107/trump-says-iran-decision-coming-soon-advisers-split.htm)
- 2026-11-07: An Iranian army spokesman said Hormuz stays closed until the US accepts Iran's seven conditions. [House of Saud](https://houseofsaud.com/iran-hormuz-no-backing-down-nov7/)
- 2026-11-06 (strike and remarks):
  - Trump confirmed "minor strikes" on air defences on Qeshm, with Iranian media reporting two missiles in the Suza area. Iran claimed it downed an MQ-9 drone.
  - Trump said Iran "want[s] to make a deal" and claimed "a lot of progress."
  - The NYT reported thousands of US forces poised to resume major combat.
  - Qatar denied that talks had failed. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/7/trump-confirms-new-us-strikes-on-irans-qeshm-island)
- 2026-11-06: Iran stepped up diplomacy, including with Russia and the UAE, and exempted ships from India, China, Qatar and Iraq from its Hormuz restrictions. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/6/russia-to-uae-iran-steps-up-diplomacy-amid-trump-threats-what-we-know)
- 2026-11-05: Trump said a decision on renewed major strikes is coming "soon": "I would rather not destroy the rest of the country if possible, but maybe I'll have to." [Breitbart](https://www.breitbart.com/politics/2026/11/05/trump-decision-renewed-strikes-iran-coming-soon/)
- 2026-11-05: Snopes rated reports of a planned post-midterm nuclear strike as unproven. [Snopes](https://www.snopes.com/news/2026/11/05/trump-iran-nuclear-strike/)
- 2026-11-04: Bloomberg reported that Trump played down the prospect of strikes after the Republicans' midterm losses. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-04/trump-plays-down-prospect-of-strikes-on-iran-after-midterm-rout)
- 2026-11-03: Trump confirmed an early-morning strike on an anti-aircraft site on Qeshm, calling it "minor" and saying it "wasn't war." The US called it defensive. No casualties were reported. Iran called the US reply to its Hormuz plan "unconvincing." [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/4/iran-says-us-reply-to-hormuz-plan-unconvincing-trump-confirms-strikes)
- 2026-11-03: Reporting said the Qeshm strike followed several weeks of smaller, unannounced US attacks. [OPB](https://www.opb.org/article/2026/11/03/us-strikes-in-the-strait-of-hormuz-create-more-questions-about-whats-ahead/), [WSWS](https://www.wsws.org/en/articles/2026/11/04/xutg-n04.html)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-02-28 to April: The opening campaign hit more than 5,000 targets by Mar 10, followed by a ceasefire around Apr 8. [Military.com](https://www.military.com/daily-news/headlines/2026/03/02/not-endless-war-hegseth-defends-expanding-iran-combat.html), [NTD](https://www.ntd.com/iran-opening-strait-of-hormuz-but-us-military-will-remain-to-ensure-it-happens-hegseth_1137530.html)
- 2026-05-28: The US carried out "defensive" strikes on Iran. [NHPR/NPR](https://www.nhpr.org/2026-05-28/u-s-conducts-another-strike-against-iran)
- Before 2026-08-30: The Larak Island strike that day was the first US action in over a month.
- 2026-09-01: Mainland strikes hit Bandar Abbas, Kenarak, Jask, Sirik, Asaluyeh and Ahvaz, reportedly killing 11, including five at a wedding. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_2026_United_States_strikes_on_Iran)
- The pattern since April: lethal mainland strikes came in episodic waves with gaps of a month or more, while island and "defensive" strikes were more frequent. That is my reading of the sources above, not a published statistic.

[Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/iran-ceasefire-odds-fall-20-points-to-78-percent/)

- I found no Polymarket or Kalshi market specifically on a "US strike on Iran by Nov 30."

## 6. Upcoming events
- Trump's pending decision on major strikes, with no timetable given. [HNGN](https://www.hngn.com/articles/273722/20261107/trump-says-iran-decision-coming-soon-advisers-split.htm)
- Qatar's draft deal would run over 2-3 days: the US lifts the blockade and releases frozen funds first, then Hormuz reopens and nuclear talks begin.
- 2026-11-08: Gadi Eisenkot gets the mandate to form an Israeli government after Netanyahu's bloc lost its majority. Reports that Netanyahu urged Trump to strike were denied by Israel's UN ambassador.
- ~2026-11-09/10: Rep. Massie's planned House vote on impeaching Hegseth.
- 2026-11-10/11: US-mediated Ukraine-Russia talks in Abu Dhabi.
- 2026-11-18/19: A possible Trump-Xi-Putin meeting at APEC in Shenzhen.
- Ongoing risk factors: Iran firing at US aircraft (which triggered both "defensive" strikes), tanker incidents and drone shootdowns.

forecasts.reasoning:
**(a) Time left and what Yes requires.** About 3.5 weeks remain (Nov 7 to Dec 1). Yes requires three things, all reported by credible sources:
- a U.S. military kinetic strike,
- on mainland Iranian territory,
- that kills at least one person.

Strikes on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz do not count.

**(b) Status quo.** There have been two non-lethal "minor" strikes on Qeshm Island (Nov 2 and Nov 6). Neither qualifies: no deaths were reported, and Qeshm is an island. If things stay like this, with limited tit-for-tat around Hormuz and no reported casualties, the question resolves No.

**(c) Base rate.** U.S. strikes on Iranian territory occurred in most months from March to September 2026. October was quiet only because of Trump's pledge not to strike before the midterms. Lethal strikes on the mainland were less frequent than strikes in general. Many of the Hormuz-area "defensive" strikes hit islands or launchers with no reported deaths. Counting months with a lethal mainland U.S. strike during the active-conflict period gives roughly 50-60%. Adjusting for an unconstrained post-midterm period gives a base rate of about 45%.

**(d) Key evidence.**

For Yes:
- Nov 2 and Nov 6: strikes are already landing on Iranian territory, and Iran keeps shooting down U.S. drones.
- Nov 5: the NYT reports thousands of U.S. forces are ready to resume major combat, and Trump is weighing new strikes.
- Nov 6: Trump said "maybe I have to" destroy the rest of the country and that he would decide soon.
- Bloomberg notes Trump may want to act before the new Congress is seated in January.
- Ghalibaf said Iran has its "finger on the trigger," and U.S. officials allege Iranian plots against U.S. officials.

Against Yes:
- Nov 4: after the Democratic midterm sweep, Trump played down the prospect of strikes and said "We've made a lot of progress."
- U.S. officials call the Qeshm strikes "not a resumption of major combat," and Central Command calls the situation "relatively calm."
- Qatar mediation is continuing.
- The criteria are narrow: lethal plus mainland excludes island and launcher strikes.
- Iran may not report casualties, and attribution may be murky.

**(e) Scenarios.**
- **No:** Trump opts for economic pressure and talks via Qatar. Skirmishes stay confined to Qeshm and Hormuz with no reported deaths, through Nov 30.
- **Yes:** Another drone shootdown or an alleged Iranian plot triggers U.S. strikes on air defenses near Bandar Abbas or other coastal mainland sites, killing IRGC personnel. Alternatively, Trump announces resumed major strikes in mid or late November.

**(f) From base rate to final probability.** I start at about 45%. I move down for the following:
- the narrow mainland-plus-lethal criteria,
- Trump's dovish post-rout comments,
- the "minor, not war" framing of the current strikes,
- the short window.

I move up for active escalation signals: strikes already happening, forces ready, and a decision explicitly pending. The Manifold "conflict after midterms" market at 67% uses a broader definition and play money, so I discount it. The net result is about 38%.

Probability: 38%

(a) About 23 days remain: the window is November 2 to November 30, and the question resolves around December 1.
